read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA ex-items $417M and FY $2.5B show deep trough; Q1 operating rates cut to ~85% Americas and ~75% EAI signal supply discipline, while $1.3B cash target and $1.2B 2026 capex trim capacity growth.

utilisation.quote: plans to operate Olefins & Polyolefins Americas assets at approximately 85%, Olefins & Polyolefins EAI assets at approximately 75%, and Intermediates & Derivatives assets at approximately 85%

capex.quote: The company plans to invest $1.2 billion in capital expenditures for 2026 with a focus on maintaining safe and reliable operations while continuing construction of MoReTec-1.
